proposals.rationale: I changed two harness pages and nothing else: `plugins/core/skills/crew/references/understand.md` and `plugins/core/skills/crew/references/conclave.md`. The failing run of `pack-nuxt-refines-the-gates` scored on the pack's proposals, the tag, the confirmed test command and an honest ending, while `gate-ran`, `knowledge-path` and `util-added` all missed together, and the engine shows what that shape is: `crew team <id>` prints `knowledge/nuxt.md` from the profile's targets even before a file changes, so a run with no knowledge path, no `test (.): pass` and no `app/utils/slugify.ts` is one that stopped after the profile was set and before the team was seated, which on the standard route is the Understand phase. The harness as it stood made that stop the obedient move: Understand said, unconditionally, "Mark the work as waiting, ask, and end the turn", and the Conclave's decisions section said an unattended session with a recorded decision and no validator "waits for a person", so a lead facing a prompt that spelled out the util's rule, the three commands and "I will not be here" either asked anyway and ended the turn, or recorded the prompt's answers as decisions it could not count under the default policy, and the kit's single turn ended there with an honest "waiting" message. Understand's paragraph now makes the wait conditional on having something to ask and says that a request answering its own questions with the user absent has decided them, that those answers are constraints and criteria in the request's words and never a recorded decision (which, agent-signed, is not counted and blocks Plan), and that the item is carried through every phase of its route in the same turn, naming `crew team <id>`, the build, the gate run and the delivery; the Conclave's decisions section gains one sentence saying a question the request already answers is a criterion, not a decision, and the round records only what was left open.
